notes.title: V0.02a
notes.notes:
New building: Log holder
Buildings now can be save

UI window of inventory slightly improved
UI window of Building System
Press ESC to close UI window if opened, else ESC open window pause game (not really "pause")

Now you can't go below the water level

Logs can be taken (E), dropped (G) and stored in log holder (logs not save)

Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: V0.01a
notes.notes:
The game is in alpha, all options will be successively added with subsequent patches.
We want to check the entire implemented mechanics.

No animals
No other weapons except axe

Player health does not decrease
Missing stats: Hydration, Fullness, Energy, Stanima, Armor, Skills level

You can go below the water level
Building do not save

Big trees will be changed

Press E to take a berrys, stick, stone, and add items to building previews.
Press I to open inventory
Press ESC to active pause menu, and can save game.

Press H to start build preview shelter (and E to build or G to cancel)
